description:
Job Title: Zendesk Developer

We are seeking a talented Zendesk Developer to join our dynamic team. As a Zendesk Developer, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our customer support platform and ensuring a seamless experience for our users.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement customized solutions within the Zendesk platform to meet business requirements.
  • Integrate Zendesk with other systems and applications to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
  • Create and maintain Zendesk apps, triggers, automations, and workflows to optimize customer support operations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Stay updated on Zendesk best practices, new features, and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Zendesk Developer or similar role, with a strong understanding of Zendesk architecture and APIs.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and experience with RESTful APIs.
  • Ability to analyze complex problems, propose solutions, and implement them effectively within Zendesk.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Zendesk certifications or training would be a plus.

Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work with a passionate team dedicated to innovation and excellence.
  • Professional development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.
  • A supportive work environment that values creativity, diversity, and teamwork.
  • Chance to make a real impact by improving customer experiences through cutting-edge Zendesk solutions.

If you are a Zendesk Developer looking to take your career to the next level and contribute to a forward-thinking organization, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and be part of our exciting journey!


Having a way to create invoices is a must.


The only submissions we'll take into account are the ones that perform a task as per below.


Show us an app/integration you've built in Zendesk, demo it in a 5min video recording with Loom and send it to us on our website over roca dot work.


Salary €2000-€3000
